entries.license: Project data (owner decision 2026-10-28); the codes are schema.org ItemAvailability members (CC BY-SA 3.0, attribution in NOTICE)
entries.justification: The availability type vocabulary (`type:availability`, `normalize.vocab`, read for `schema:ItemAvailability` fields): the page stock wording the owner maps to the schema.org ItemAvailability members InStock and OutOfStock (owner decision 2026-10-28), and the Open Graph product availability values (`og:availability`, Pinterest product rich pins, https://developers.pinterest.com/docs/web-features/product-rich-pins/: `instock`, `preorder`, `backorder` or `pending`, `out of stock`, `discontinued`) that are no member name: `pending`, back in stock soon, is BackOrder; `oos`, the short form of `out of stock` that pages write in `og:availability`, is OutOfStock. The others are member names or their words already. Terms match by token form, case, hyphens and spacing aside. A member's own name, and its words written apart, state that member without this file. A term from this file is not evidence of availability by itself (`Ok.checked`).
